ccpa_description: Falsely stating or implying urgency or scarcity to mislead a user into an immediate purchase or action
Falsely stating or implying urgency or scarcity to mislead a user into an immediate purchase or action
Showing false popularity of a product or service to manipulate the user's decision
Using a phrase, video, audio or other means to create fear, shame, ridicule or guilt to nudge the user into an action
Highlighting certain information and obscuring other relevant information to misdirect the user from the action they intended
Deliberately using confusing or vague language to misguide or divert the user from taking the desired action
Making cancellation of a paid subscription impossible or complex, or hiding the cancellation option
Including additional items, such as products, services or donations, at checkout without the user's consent
Not revealing elements of the price upfront, or revealing them surreptitiously within the user experience
Forcing the user into an action that requires buying additional goods, subscribing to an unrelated service or sharing personal information
